member.name: T:Realm.Ecs.Services.CombatResolver
member.summary:
One ordered damage pipeline for every source: attacks, splash, spells, abilities and periodic effects. The stages, in order, are:
Raw damage: authored or scaled magnitude, plus variance, plus an optional critical.
Effective resistance: the target's resistance for the damage type, reduced by percentage penetration and then by flat penetration, never below zero. Pure damage skips this stage entirely.
Mitigation: R / (R + K), capped by .
Damage floor: a resisted hit still deals , while pure damage keeps whatever it rolled.
Percentage resistance bonuses never re-enter this pipeline: they are folded into the resistance points once, by the stat pipeline, so no chain of percentage effects can compound with itself.
